note:
SOURCE: wave `block-pdrn-research-crows-feet`, slot `pdrn-cf--tight-b`, nbp_flash candidate 01. Master 4096x4096, published at 3000. Class B — no references, no product in frame.

WHY THIS CANDIDATE AND NOT THE ONES THAT LOOKED BETTER. Four finalists were checked at native pixels against the honesty rules in docs/clinical-trial-before-after-images.md §3. Three failed, including the two that topped the contact sheet:
  tight-a gpt_image   her skin is lighter and cooler in the right panel and the temple moles do not
                      correspond — 'no lighter skin in the right panel' is a named rule
  tight-a seedream    identity anchors hold, but the sun spots across her cheek largely clear up —
                      her pigmentation improved, not just her lines
  tight-c nbp_flash   lines VANISH rather than shallow, a raised mole disappears, she reads visibly
                      younger. Nearer 70% than 20%
  tight-b nbp_flash   PASS — the melasma patch, the temple mole and the freckles are in identical
                      places at identical strength in both panels, skin tone matches, and every
                      crow's-foot line is still present, only shallower

The lesson is worth keeping: THE FRAME THAT LOOKS BEST ON A CONTACT SHEET IS THE ONE THAT CHEATS MOST. A downscale hides vanished lines and rewards a brighter, cleaner 'after'. Judge this brief family at native pixels BEFORE ranking, never after.

THE COHORT IS CHINESE AND THE CASTING MATCHES IT. Ye R et al. (2026), PLOS ONE 10.1371/journal.pone.0350905, read on 2026-08-27: 'Thirty-one healthy Chinese female volunteers aged 35-55 years (mean 47.5 +/- 5.7)'. The acetyl document carries the same question as OPEN and unresolved (An 2019 studied 52 Korean women while every acetyl casting wave has been Caucasian). Here it is simply answered by casting to the cohort. That question is still open for /pages/acetyl-hexapeptide-8-research.

SPLIT-FACE IS NOT WHAT THE PICTURE SHOWS, DELIBERATELY. One side of each subject's face got 0.1% PDRN-850K, the other 0.1% retinol. The ~20% is the PDRN side's change from ITS OWN BASELINE at day 28 (retinol managed about -6%). So the image is before/after on ONE side of ONE face over 28 days, and 'no comparison of the two sides of one face' was negated by name. A frame showing both of her eyes differing from each other would depict the PDRN-versus-retinol result, which is a stronger claim than the heading makes. FLUX.2 produced exactly that fault on slot half-f — a mirrored half-face — and is excluded.

THE LABELS ARE HTML, NOT PIXELS. `research-before-after` renders Before / After 28 days / the result line / 'Illustration' as DOM text over the image. That matters for two reasons: no engine ever renders a number, so a percentage cannot be garbled into a false efficacy claim (MATRIXYL failed ~30 of 50 candidates; a correct PDRN was resampled into PORN); and the text stays translatable — Translate & Adapt reaches theme JSON as ONLINE_STORE_THEME_JSON_TEMPLATE resources but cannot touch pixels. `note_label: Illustration` is the honesty device already established on the acetyl page and is carried over unchanged.

THE STRUCTURAL CHANGE, AND WHY THE ALTERNATION IS TOUCHED. `key_findings` keeps f2 (the mechanism diagram) and f3; f1 moves into the new section above it. media-with-text derives left/right from BLOCK INDEX when `alternate_media_position` is true, so removing f1 would have flipped both survivors and put two image-left rows next to each other. Alternation is therefore switched off and the two remaining blocks carry explicit positions — f2 `end`, f3 `start` — which reproduces the current left / right / left rhythm exactly.

SQUARE MASTER, AND THE CROP THIS BLOCK ACTUALLY SUFFERS. Measured live: the f1 box is 660x663 at 1440, 540x669 at 1200, 490x589 at 1100, 452x613 at 1024, 704x704 at 768, 350x350 at 390. At 1024 and 1200 a square master loses ~26% of its width — 13% off each side — and on a DIPTYCH that is where the subject lives, because the crow's feet sit at the outer edge of both panels. This is worse than the f2 diagram, where the outer strip was only layer bands. The `research-before-after` section may crop differently from media-with-text; that is verified live after publishing rather than assumed.

OPTIMISATION: long edge capped at 3000 (the widest the theme's srcset requests), quality 95, 4:4:4, progressive, metadata stripped, and deliberately not compressed harder — Shopify's CDN transcodes to WebP and a pre-compressed source hands it artefacts to reproduce.

SEO FILENAME: `skingenetix-pdrn-crows-feet-periorbital-wrinkles-before-after.jpg` — 65 characters, eight keywords, no word from the no-search-value list. New name, never a re-upload; Shopify suffixes a collision rather than replacing it.

images.alt: Two close-up photographs of the same woman's eye taken four weeks apart, side by side, the fan of lines at the outer corner less deeply etched in the later image. Illustration accompanying the PDRN research summary.
